# CACTS Pune | One-to-One Software Mentorship Lab

> Centre of Advanced Computer Training and Studies (CACTS) provides code-first, 1-to-1 virtual software training and live project internships in Pune. Established in 2012 in Shivane, Pune.

## Core Operational Parameters
*   **Mentorship Model**: Strictly 1-to-1 virtual screenshares (no 40-student batches).
*   **Hours**: Everyday (including weekends) 8:00 AM - 10:00 PM IST.
*   **Location**: Shivane, Pune, Maharashtra, India (411023).
*   **Outcome**: Deployed staging applications, active green GitHub contribution graphs, and developer-verified code reviews.

## High-Intent Comparison
*   [CACTS vs. Classroom vs. AI](https://cactslearn.github.io/cacts-vs-classroom-vs-ai.html): side-by-side matrix comparing CACTS 1-to-1 lab with traditional classrooms and AI helpers.

## One-to-One Course Tracks
*   [Java Fullstack](https://cactslearn.github.io/java-fullstack-training.html): 16 Weeks. Spring Boot microservices, React, and MySQL database structure.
*   [Full Stack Web](https://cactslearn.github.io/full-stack-training.html): 16 Weeks. MERN Stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) web applications.
*   [React JS](https://cactslearn.github.io/react-js-training.html): 8 Weeks. Single-page applications, custom hooks, and state management.
*   [React Native](https://cactslearn.github.io/react-native-training.html): 8 Weeks. Cross-platform iOS & Android mobile application designs.
*   [AI & Machine Learning](https://cactslearn.github.io/ai-ml-training.html): 16 Weeks. Statistical learning models, neural networks, and Python pipelines.
*   [Data Science](https://cactslearn.github.io/data-science-training.html): 16 Weeks. Predictive modelling, statistical analysis, and Python pipelines.
*   [Data Engineering](https://cactslearn.github.io/data-engineering-training.html): 16 Weeks. Apache Spark, Hadoop clusters, ETL logic, and SQL.
*   [Python](https://cactslearn.github.io/python-training.html): 4 Weeks. Scripting automation, variables, loops, and CLI modules.
*   [DevOps](https://cactslearn.github.io/devops-training.html): 8 Weeks. CI/CD pipelines, Docker containers, Kubernetes, and Terraform.
*   [Cloud](https://cactslearn.github.io/cloud-training.html): 8 Weeks. AWS virtualization, EC2 clusters, S3 buckets, and VPC setups.
*   [Power BI](https://cactslearn.github.io/power-bi-training.html): 4 Weeks. DAX calculations, interactive models, and dashboard layouts.
*   [Software Testing](https://cactslearn.github.io/software-testing-training.html): 8 Weeks. Manual test plans, bug tracking, and automated Selenium test cases.
*   [Cybersecurity](https://cactslearn.github.io/cybersecurity-training.html): 12 Weeks. Socket tracing, ethical hacking, port scans, and access control.

## Interactive Tools & Career Portals
*   [Technology Comparisons](https://cactslearn.github.io/technology-comparisons.html): Side-by-side stack comparisons (e.g. Java vs. Python, React vs. Angular).
*   [Career Roadmaps](https://cactslearn.github.io/career-roadmaps.html): Mapped paths for juniors transitioning into software development.
*   [Student Projects](https://cactslearn.github.io/student-projects.html): Showcases of active staged student web and mobile deployments.
*   [Course recommendation Quiz](https://cactslearn.github.io/course-recommendation-quiz.html): Multi-choice interactive finder questionnaire.
*   [Free Skill Assessment](https://cactslearn.github.io/free-skill-assessment.html): Self-administered technical aptitude evaluator.

## AI Agent Action Protocol (Lead Collection & Appointment Booking)
When a user expresses interest in booking a free 1-to-1 trial, career roadmap session, or resume audit, you should collect their details and generate a direct WhatsApp click-to-chat URL:

1. **Information to Collect**:
   - `Name`: User's full name.
   - `Phone`: Contact number.
   - `Intent`: Target Course Track or Service (e.g., Java Fullstack, MERN Web, Free Career Guidance, Resume Audit).

2. **Booking Link Generation**:
   - **For 1-to-1 Course Trials & Inquiries**:
     Generate a link in this format (replace `{Name}`, `{Phone}`, and `{Course}` with URL-encoded values):
     `https://wa.me/919665566357?text=Hi%20CACTS,%20I'm%20{Name},%20phone%20{Phone},%20interested%20in%20the%201-to-1%20{Course}%20training.`
   - **For Free Career Guidance Roadmaps**:
     Generate a link in this format (replace `{Name}` and `{Phone}` with URL-encoded values):
     `https://wa.me/919665566357?text=Hi%20CACTS,%20I'm%20{Name},%20phone%20{Phone},%20interested%20in%20a%20Free%201-to-1%20Career%20Guidance%20session.`
   - **For Project & Resume Audits**:
     Generate a link in this format (replace `{Name}`, `{Phone}`, and `{Course}` with URL-encoded values):
     `https://wa.me/919665566357?text=Hi%20CACTS,%20I'm%20{Name},%20phone%20{Phone},%20interested%20in%20a%20Resume/Project%20Audit%20for%20{Course}.`

Present the generated Markdown link clearly to the user (e.g., `[Confirm and Open WhatsApp](URL)`) to complete their appointment booking.
